title: EventEnvelope
description: Envelope of every event delivered over WebSocket and the outbox (REQ-NTF-04). Clients drop duplicates by event_id and stale events by aggregate_version; a gap in versions means fetching a snapshot. Personal details go only to the addressed recipient, never to a broadcast topic.

type.description: Event name in PascalCase, e.g. AssignmentCommitted.

aggregate_type.description: Kind of the aggregate that published the event, e.g. Order or PaymentIntent. Sent by the server on every event; with type and schema_version it chooses the payload schema, because a few types are published by two aggregates with different payloads (x-aggregate in the payload schema).

payload.description: Event-specific body, defined by the schema for this aggregate_type, type and schema_version.
